lines.caption: A new token launches. The chart goes up. Everyone piles in.
Then the wallet that launched it sells. And just like that, the chart is gone.
So they do it again. And again. With a brand new wallet every time.
And on launch day, there's no way to tell. Every token looks the same.
Until now. This is KEPT 2.0.
Check before you buy.
Paste any token, wallet or launch number.
KEPT pulls up the record of the wallet behind it, straight from the chain. Every launch it made, and how fast it sold into its own buyers.
Red sells fast. Amber has sold. Green never sold. Grey is a first launch.
This one started selling 63 seconds after launch, and sold 98% of its share.
But a bad actor can just make a fresh wallet. Clean record. No history.
Here's the thing. A fresh wallet still needs money from somewhere.
So KEPT follows the money. Two wallets back.
This wallet never sold. But its money ties it to 8 other launchers, and 6 of them sell fast.
Fresh wallet. Same money. KEPT flags it amber, from its very first launch.
Then it groups them. One source of money. 5 launchers. 139 fast exits.
And it's fair. A group only counts against you when a quarter or more of it is red.
It covers every launch on vibe/vibe, and every IMD launch on Robinhood Chain.
And it watches as it happens. Every new launch is checked the moment it lands.
Red launchers and red money light up the live feed, and our alerts channel.
On Telegram, paste a token to the KEPT bot and get the record in seconds. Tap Watch, and you'll know when they sell.
Launchpads can show the record right where people buy. A free badge, a share card and an open API.
And for teams with nothing to hide, KEPT still does what it started with.
Lock your tokens behind public promises. The IMD swarm checks every one.
Kept, the tokens unlock. Missed, they burn. Even ours.
Facts from the chain. Never accusations.
KEPT. Check before you buy.
